common_ground.text: Keystone firmware and Zodl on iOS are not a problem for NU7. Anirudh-712 accepted str4d's correction and updated his list.
ZSAs are not part of NU7.

output.headline: NU7 timeline: mainnet activation set for November 5, 2026, with 25-second blocks and v4 transactions disabled
output.next: Mainnet activation is set for November 5, 2026, at block 3,543,405. PulseHawk estimates that block lands around 6 November 02:26 UTC and will post the first counted intervals here.

unresolved.text: Will ZSAs go into a later upgrade? One reply says the status is 'Debate'; another says the plan is to ready the code and test it, without including it in NU7.
Can old Sprout funds be recovered after NU7? Nothing definitive is decided; a redemption mechanism is discussed elsewhere.
Which wallets can still send after activation? KeepKey, ShapeShift, Trust Wallet Core and the original MIT SDKs still show no fix.

best_for.quote: there is now unanimous agreement among the orgs and engineering teams throughout the Zcash ecosystem.

views.label: NU7 goes ahead on the announced schedule
views.one_line: NU7 is proceeding. The orgs and engineering teams agree on testnet on October 6 and mainnet on November 5, 2026.

best_against.quote: There are no changes to transaction formats, signing algorithms etc.

best_for.quote: KeepKey, ShapeShift, Trust Wallet Core and the original MIT SDKs still look the same after re-checking.

views.label: Some wallets may not be ready for Nov 5
views.one_line: A few wallets and SDKs still show no NU7 fix (KeepKey, ShapeShift, Trust Wallet Core, the old MIT SDKs), and users need their wallet's own update before they are safe.

best_for.quote: I personally think ZSAs would be a huge feature for zcash.

views.label: Add ZSAs soon
views.one_line: ZSAs would be a huge feature for Zcash. NU7 leaves them out, and these posters hope to see the new transaction format soon.

output.why_it_matters: Mainnet moves to 25-second blocks and v4 transactions stop working. Nodes, indexers and explorers may be affected, and old Sprout funds become effectively unspendable.
